gaps: Breath one placed the yield in the second pass and the crossing as the artifact. Swap and compare and Combiner's arithmetic put the yield in the joining rule, a seat with no case before it; the changed question for breath two is what the thickness of the crossing does to where the judgment sits and which degradation arrives.
accepted: Swap and compare: the same adjudication is run twice with the seats' occupants exchanged, and the two verdicts meet at a rule that can say only whether they agree, so the composition yields a distinction no single run holds, a verdict that belongs to the idea against one that belongs to the seat, as the atlas's trial that reruns with the advocate's and adversary's models swapped and returns contested when the verdict flips, the crossover trial that gives each patient both treatments in both orders so that the order effect is separated from the drug, the counterbalanced experiment and the Latin square, the referee pair reversed for the second leg; the composition's shape is a pass and its mirror image; what crosses between the runs is nothing, since the second run must not know the first's verdict, and the only meeting is at the comparator; the judgment sits in the comparator's rule, which cannot say which run was right, only that the pair is unstable, so the yield is a label on the pair and the unstable case is handed on as residue rather than resolved; the degradation is agreement for a shared reason, since two occupants who carry the same prior give the same verdict in either seat and the rule reads that as stability of the idea when it is symmetry of the prior, the two laboratories that replicate each other with the same reagent lot; the tell that separates the two is a swap that never flips on any claim, which measures the occupants' sameness and not the ideas' soundness; observed in the trial's design and in crossover trials, and the atlas's corpus holds no trial transcript, so the repo case is a rule and not yet a result; not denominator-manufactures' second net, which counts what the two nets missed, since here nothing is counted and the yield is a stability label on one verdict.

Judges who cannot see each other: each of two or more judges reads the same question on the same named axis without seeing the others' reads, and the composition yields the spread, which no single judge can produce because one read has no spread, and the spread localizes where the question underdetermines its answer, as the atlas's triangulation that refuses to run with one judge and names any axis where the reads split in sign as contested residue for an owner, the first round of a Delphi panel before the estimates are fed back, the two radiologists who read the film before conferring, the census count and the post-enumeration survey kept from each other's rosters; the composition's shape is parallel reads joined only at a table; what crosses is the axis wording, from whoever dimensionalized the question to every judge, and nothing between the judges; the judgment sits nowhere, since the composition's output on a contested axis is a name and an owner rather than a verdict, and only on an uncontested axis does it compress to a number; the degradation is consensus collapse, which arrives the moment a judge can see another's read, the Delphi second round that converges on the median, the jury room, the reviewer who reads the other reviews first, so that the spread narrows without the question changing; the tell is a spread that shrinks with the order in which the reads were taken; a second degradation is that the axes were one judge's, since the first judge dimensionalizes when no axes are given, so the panel disagrees only inside one judge's frame and an axis nobody named is contested by nobody; observed in the triangulation's design and in Delphi panels; not Combiner's arithmetic, which holds what the table does to the reads once they are in, since here the mechanism is the wall between the judges.

Second family's difference: the same enumeration is run by two enumerators with different priors, and the composition yields the difference of their lists, which is a distinction about the members, that a member is reachable from one prior and not the other, rather than a bigger pile, as two field guides to the same coast whose birds each lacks, two dictionaries' headword lists, the atlas's refusal to accept two identical judge commands as a panel, since identical judges are one judge; the composition's shape is two passes over one question joined at a set difference; what crosses is the question and nothing else; the judgment sits in the reader of the difference, who must decide whether an item only one family reached is the family's artifact or the subject's member that the other family cannot see; the degradation is the vote, which keeps the intersection and discards the difference, so a majority over families returns the members every prior already held and throws away the only thing the composition made, and the second degradation is families that share a corpus, whose difference is empty for a reason the composition cannot see; the tell of a spent composition is a difference that shrinks as the families are made more capable, since capable families converge on the modal members; analytical, since the atlas's climb ledgers name the hand that made each breath and fifty-five of eighty-two lists were bred by more than one hand, so the difference set is computable and has not been computed; adds to denominator-manufactures' second net, which uses the two nets' overlap to estimate what both missed, the reading of the non-overlap as a member class; not Blind judge, which rates the passes, since here no one rates and the difference is the yield.

Blind judge: candidates from two or more passes are pooled and stripped of their source before a judge rates them, so the composition yields a rating of the passes, which no pass can give itself and which a judge who knew the source would give to the source, as the orchestra audition behind a screen, the 1976 Paris tasting in which French judges ranked Californian wines first, blind peer review, the parsimony climb that accepts a deletion only if it survives a defence made without knowing who proposed the cut; the composition's shape is a fan-in with the labels removed; what crosses is the candidates without their provenance, and the provenance is held back by a third hand who re-attaches it after the rating; the judgment sits in the judge, but the yield is read by the hand that holds the labels; the degradation is de-blinding by voice, since each pass writes in a register and the judge reads the register as the source, the screen that does not hide the sound of heels, the reviewer who recognizes the laboratory from the methods section, so that the rating of the passes becomes a rating of registers; the tell is a rating that reproduces the source labels better than chance when the labels are checked; observed outside in auditions and the tasting, analytical in the atlas, whose records carry the hand that made them in the made_by field that the critic seat reads, so the seat is not blind and the map's rating of its own passes has not been made; adds to witness-architectures' instrument that must be built not to see, the case where what it must not see is the hand that made the candidate.

Combiner's arithmetic: several reads cross as numbers to a table whose rule decides what a disagreement becomes, and the composition yields either a verdict no reader gave or the disagreement as a member, according to the rule and not the reads, as the ensemble forecast whose mean track runs between two storm tracks through water no member predicted, the trimmed mean of the diving panel, the atlas's trial that returns contested on a sign split and refuses to average, its triangulation that reports the spread beside the mean; the composition's shape is a fan-in through arithmetic; what crosses is a number per read, since the reasons are stripped at the table; the judgment sits in the rule, which was written before any read was taken, so the map's most consequential seat is one that had no case in front of it; the degradation is averaging the shape away, a mean of plus and minus that reads as balance, and its mirror, a contested threshold so wide that every panel is contested and the composition never compresses; the tell of the first is a verdict at the middle of the scale that no read occupied, and of the second an owner list as long as the axis list; observed in ensemble forecasting and in the trial's rule; not Judges who cannot see each other, which holds the wall that makes the reads independent, since the table's rule does its work on reads however they were made.

Embedding neighbour pair: a pass that measures nearness in an embedding hands a reader a pair of items and a number, and the composition yields the pairs a reader would never have compared, since a reader compares neighbours in list order and a list of eighty-five has three thousand five hundred and seventy pairs, so the wrong-grain tell in item-grains, the eighty-five that is twelve with synonyms, becomes readable at scale, as the plagiarism report that shows two passages side by side with a percentage, the patent search that returns the nearest claims, the near-duplicate pass over a corpus before the editors read it; the composition's shape is a filter that proposes pairs and a reader who rules on them; what crosses is a pair and a number; the judgment sits in the reader, but the reader's queue was set by the number; the degradation is anchoring by the number, since two items near in embedding share a domain and a vocabulary and may differ in mechanism, and a reader shown a pair labelled near merges what a cold read would have kept, while two rephrasings that use disjoint vocabulary never reach the reader at all; the tell is a merge whose surviving text has to be lengthened to hold both mechanisms; analytical, since the atlas embeds every list for ordering and the same vectors would serve this filter, and it has not been run; adds to item-grains' wrong-grain tell the composition that can read it over more pairs than a reader can hold.

Gap named by one hand: one pass induces a typology over the list and names the cells that are empty or thin, a second pass fills the named cell, and nothing crosses between them but the cell's name, so the composition yields members in a region the flat pass would not reach and the yield's quality is set by what the name carries, as the atlas's climb, whose strong tier names up to three missing types and whose cheap tier is shown the list and the type name and asked for six members, and against it Mendeleev's eka-silicon, whose empty cell crossed to Winkler not as a name but as a predicted atomic weight, density, and oxide, so that the filler could recognize germanium when it was in the crucible; the composition's shape is a namer and a filler in series; what crosses is a name, or in the strong form a name with predicted properties; the judgment sits in the namer, since the filler answers the name, and the gate that judges the fill judges it against the list and not against the typology, which never crosses to the gate at all; the degradation is the cell's name plus a case, the item that reads as the type's label applied to the nearest example, which form-yields names as the manufactured item's tell; the tell here is a fill whose members all contain the type name; observed in the climb's design and in the periodic table; adds to form-yields' empty cell, which holds what the form makes visible, the fact that in a composition the cell's name is the only thing the filler sees, so the yield rises with what the namer was made to predict and not with the filler's tier.

Measure then name: an engine orders a list by measured similarity and a second pass names the axis the order runs along and votes on whether the axis is revelatory, so the composition yields an order nobody authored and a claim nobody measured, as the atlas's seriation, whose engine picks the smoother of a spectral and a greedy order, whose strong-tier namer may reverse the direction and marks its own name revelatory or clustering, and factor analysis, whose rotation is computed and whose factor is named by the psychologist, so that neuroticism and the general factor carry the computation's authority on a name the computation never produced; the composition's shape is a measurer and a namer in series; what crosses is the ordered items without the numbers, and a name crosses back; the judgment sits in the namer, who cannot fail, since every order gets a name, and whose revelatory flag is the namer's vote on the namer's own name; the degradation is a name over local clustering, a story told about an order that is three clusters in a row; the tell is a name that cannot be falsified from the order it names, and the changed move is to have the namer place a held-out item before seeing where the engine put it; a second observed shape is precedence, since the atlas's driver skips any list whose record already carries a seriation, so a fieldwork map's authored walk pre-empts the measured order for good and the only trace of which hand ordered it is the method field, model-direct against spectral; observed; adds to form-yields' named axis, which holds what an axis makes visible, the split of the axis into a measured half and a named half with no seat that holds both.

Verdict menu: a critic seat is given a menu of verdicts and an asymmetric cost for each, so the composition yields the modal verdict whatever the input, and the distribution of verdicts is a fact about the seat and not about the maps, as the atlas's thirty-eight critiques across three fleets that all returned admit-with-repairs and never admit, return-for-another-breath, or reject, the reviewer's minor revisions, the audit that finds three findings because an audit with none is suspected of not having looked, the grade that compresses toward B-plus; the composition's shape is an author, a critic with a menu, and a repairer who applies the verdict; what crosses into the seat is the record, the ledger, and the menu, and what crosses out is one word from the menu and a list of repairs; the judgment sits in the menu's costs, since a verdict that kills the map costs the seat a defence, a verdict that admits it unrepaired costs the seat its evidence of having read, and the middle option costs nothing; the degradation is the verdict attractor, a distribution with no variance over inputs of different quality; the tell is that variance, readable only across many maps and by whoever holds the fleet's ledger and never by the seat, whose every verdict was locally reasonable; observed, with the same shape inside the verdict, since the thirty-eight critiques made two hundred and eight repairs, one hundred and thirty-eight keeps, and three cuts, so the repair decision is the item-level middle option as admit-with-repairs is the map-level one; not the critic's judgment on any item, which may each be right, since the mechanism is in the menu.

Cheap proposer, strong gate: a cheap pass proposes many candidates and a strong pass judges each against the list, so the composition yields volume the strong pass would not spend on and a recorded refusal for every drop, which is a labelled nonmember no single pass produces, as the atlas's climb whose cheap tier offers fifteen and whose strong-tier gate keeps or drops each with a reason written to the ledger, the patent examiner who can reject only the claims the applicant drafted, the acquisitions desk over the slush pile, the journal whose quality is bounded by what is submitted; the composition's shape is a proposer and a gate that can only subtract; what crosses is the candidates as text and the list to both sides; the judgment sits in the gate, but the frontier of the list sits in the proposer, since the gate cannot add, so a strong gate spends its taste sorting a cheap prior's rephrasings and the list's edge is the proposer's edge; the degradation is the plateau read as exhaustion, since a falling keep rate measures the proposer's frontier meeting the list and the flag cannot say whether the subject ran out or the proposer did, which enumeration-stalls holds; the second degradation is refusal without memory, since the gate is shown the list and never the ledger's residue, so a candidate refused last breath can be proposed and refused again as new; the tell of a spent proposer is a keep rate that tracks the proposer's tier and not the subject; observed; adds to enumeration-stalls' plateau the fact that the stall in this composition is the proposer's and the gate is the wrong seat to read it from.

Earliest slip: many narrow readers each send a slip with a quotation and a date to one editor, and the composition yields an ordering, the earliest attestation, that no reader could produce because each reader has one book, as the Oxford English Dictionary's reading programme, whose volunteers' slips gave each sense its first date, and the antedatings that arrived once newspaper archives were searchable, which showed how many first dates had been first-in-the-canon; the composition's shape is a fan-in of narrow passes to one combiner who sorts; what crosses is the slip, a case with a date and nothing of the reader's judgment; the judgment sits in the editor who sorts and defines, and the readers hold none of it; the degradation is the readers' corpus, since the earliest slip is the earliest in what the readers read, and the ordering inherits the canon's bias without any reader having chosen it; the tell is an antedating that arrives from a corpus of a new kind rather than from another reader of the old kind; observed; adds to denominator-manufactures' accumulation curve, which flattens as readers of one corpus saturate, the fact that the ordering yield saturates before the member count does, since a later reader of the same books can add a sense and not an earlier date; not Cheap proposer, strong gate, where the gate refuses, since the editor here refuses nothing and sorts.

Cut-only hand with a rewrite slot: the last hand in the composition may only apply the critic's cuts and repairs and may add nothing, so the composition yields provenance, every surviving item is the author's and the critic's taste enters only as subtraction, and the map cannot drift toward the critic's mode; but the repair carries a slot for full replacement text, so the cut-only rule is porous and a repaired item is a member the critic authored under the author's name, as the atlas's repairer, forbidden to add items and instructed to apply each repair's replacement text verbatim, the copy editor who may only cut and rewrites in the margin, the appellate court that may only affirm, reverse, or remand and writes the opinion the trial court must follow; the composition's shape is author, critic, repairer in series with a one-way valve at the end; what crosses is a critique with a decision per item and a replacement text for each repair; the judgment sits in the critic, but the authorship of the final text sits in whoever filled the slot; the degradation is the leak, since a repair that changes the cases or the mechanism is an addition the rule forbade, and the ledger then counts it as kept, so the keep rate reads one while the text is another hand's; the tell is a repaired item whose cases changed, and across the thirty-eight critiques the seat made two hundred and eight repairs and three cuts, so the slot, not the valve, is where the critic's hand entered the atlas; observed; adds to environment-loops' keep rate of one by construction the mechanism inside the construction, the slot through which the count stays one while the text changes.

Trial with a burden: an advocate and an adversary build opposing cases under one scaffold and a judge reads the transcript under a burden set by the claim's class, so the composition yields grounds, the argument that decided it, which a judge reading the bare claim cannot name because without an opposing case nothing decided anything, as the atlas's trial whose judge must answer with a lean and one sentence naming the deciding argument, the moot court, the adversarial hearing whose finding of fact cites the cross-examination; the composition's shape is two opposed passes and a reader; what crosses is the opposing case to each side, and the whole transcript to the judge; the judgment sits in the judge, with the burden's threshold set by a hand that never saw the case, and an unproven claim is rejected rather than split; the degradation is the last word, since a balanced scaffold still has an order, and in the atlas's cross-examination the adversary answers last in every round, while the courtroom gives the last word to the side that carries the burden, so the two designs balance opposite asymmetries and neither is symmetric; the second degradation is eloquence, which the judge is told to disregard and which the transcript carries anyway; the tell is a verdict that moves when the order of the closing turns is reversed with the arguments held fixed; observed in the trial's design and the courtroom's, with no atlas transcript on record; not Swap and compare, which exchanges the occupants, since here the seats keep their occupants and the mechanism is the order of the seats.

Sovereign charters at maximin: each party to a negotiation scores only its own declared constraints, proposal rights rotate, and at impasse the surviving proposal is the one whose worst satisfaction is highest, so the composition yields a proposal in the joint feasible region that no party would have proposed and, at impasse, the binding constraints, the pair that cannot both hold, which no party can name alone because each sees only its own charter, as the atlas's parley, the treaty that must pass every parliament and whose sticking clause is found only when the third parliament refuses, the class settlement whose holdout names the term nobody else had priced; the composition's shape is a ring of proposers and a rule at the end; what crosses is each proposal and each party's score of its own charter, and the charters themselves never cross; the judgment sits distributed, since no party grades another's constraints, and the impasse's yield is a named conflict handed to the residue rather than a settlement; the degradation is the hardened soft constraint, since a party that declares a preference as a hard constraint captures the maximin, and the rule cannot tell a real floor from a declared one; the tell is a binding constraint that the same party later trades away; analytical, since the parley's rule is observed in the atlas and no recorded accord or impasse is in its corpus; not Judges who cannot see each other, where the reads are of one question, since here each party reads a different charter and the yield is the conflict between charters.

residue.why: Rejected: window-successions holds what a carrier strips and who chose the stripping; here it would be a dimension of every item and not a member.

residue.item: Shuffle baseline: the engine composed with twenty random orders of itself to price its own smoothness.
residue.why: Rejected: denominator-manufactures' shuffle; nothing crosses and the yield is a universe, not a member or a distinction.

residue.item: Consult's labelled denominator: a plan checked against a list's members.

residue.why: Rejected and kept as the boundary case: the brief's own nonmember, a shape with no yield named.

residue.item: Grounds required: the judge must name the argument that decided it.
residue.why: Merged into Trial with a burden as its yield.

limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy; a real pipeline runs several of these compositions at once and the list makes no claim to cover every shape.

The atlas cases are read from the passes' code and from ledger and critique counts computed by script on 2026-09-13 (thirty-eight critiques, two hundred and eight repairs, one hundred and thirty-eight keeps, three cuts); they are counts of files, not a human read of each.
Outside cases (crossover trials, Delphi panels, the Paris tasting, ensemble forecasting, the reading programme, Mendeleev's eka-silicon) are simplified to one mechanism each.
The doctrine of splitting generator from critic is the catalog's own and is not an item.

Neighbouring maps: form-yields holds what a form does to a pile; denominator-manufactures the universe; register-yields one register's artifact; enumeration-stalls the stall; environment-loops the loop back to the same reasoner; window-successions the carrier's loss.

gaps: The changed question, what the thickness of the crossing does to the seat of judgment and the degradation, and whether a crossing can undo its composition, yielded four members the first framing hid: a seat's own distribution crossing as an instruction (Telling the seat its attractor), the author's rejections crossing to the critic through the required ledger (Residue crossing to the fresh critic, measured at eleven of thirty-eight), the whole record crossing to a checker that holds identity by string (Cascade from the first pass), and a second register crossing nothing but the subject (Register rotation diff). The walk re-sorted from where the judgment sits to what crosses, which put the degradations in order: made of what did not cross on the thin half, of what did on the thick half. The territory pointer stands and the slug is kept.
accepted: Telling the seat its attractor: a distribution produced by a composition's own seat is reported back to the seat as an instruction before the next run, and the composition yields a shifted distribution set by the instruction, which is still not set by the maps, as this fleet's critic brief, which names the thirty-eight admit-with-repairs to the seat and calls an admit with zero repairs a finding, the grade-inflation memo that produces a year of deflation, the audit team told that every prior audit found three findings; the composition's shape is a seat, a ledger that counts its verdicts, and a hand that writes the count into the next brief; what crosses is the prior distribution, condensed to one sentence, as an instruction; the judgment sits in the instruction's author, since the seat now proves it can return each verdict; the degradation is the second attractor, a distribution that tracks the last report rather than the maps, so a fleet with a distribution correction reads well against the previous fleet and not against its inputs; the tell is a verdict distribution that shifts in the direction of the instruction across maps of the same quality, and it is readable only from a third fleet whose brief carries no report; speculative, since this fleet's critiques have not run and the shift is predicted; not Verdict menu, which holds the attractor the menu sets, since here the attractor is set by the report of the last attractor, and the loop between them is the map's.

Residue crossing to the fresh critic: the critic seat is denied the author's reasoning and given the record and the ledger, and the ledger carries the author's residue, the candidates the author rejected with why, so what was meant to be a fresh read of the fence arrives with the author's fence already drawn, and the composition yields, per map, a fact about the critic's boundary case, whether it is the author's residue re-read or a fence the author never tested, as the atlas's critique briefs that forbid the author's reasoning and require the ledger, and the eleven of thirty-eight critiques whose boundary case names one of the author's residue items, the reviewer sent the authors' response to an earlier round, the second radiologist handed the first's negative findings; the composition's shape is author then critic with a partial wall; what crosses is the artifact and, through the ledger, the author's rejections; the judgment sits in the critic on the items and in the author on the fence, whenever the fence crossed; the degradation is the re-read, a boundary case that is the author's tempting nonmember returned with the author's ruling, so the composition's independence was spent everywhere except where the practice's sharpening check wanted it; the tell is readable from the two files without reading either map, a residue handle inside the critique's boundary case; observed at eleven of thirty-eight by a string match on the residue handle, so the true rate is at least that; adds to fertile-forgettings' loss that creates a capacity the case where the loss was declared and did not occur, and to window-successions' ledger the fact that the ledger was built for the successor breath and is read by the critic as well.

Cascade from the first pass: a change made by one pass is read by a later pass that reports every consequence as its own finding, so the composition yields a count of dependents, which edges rested on the changed item, that neither pass could list alone, and the same channel manufactures spurious failures, as the compiler that reports forty type errors from one missing bracket, the atlas's checker that compares relation endpoints to items by exact string and reports every edge whose endpoint was repaired, the repair brief that warns the repairer to update every place the old string appears; the composition's shape is a writer and a checker in series with identity carried by text; what crosses is the whole record, and the item's text is its identity, so a repair is a new item and every edge to it is an edge to nothing; the judgment sits in the checker, which reports all violations at once so the repairer can fix in one pass, and which cannot tell a broken edge from an edge whose label no longer argues what its new endpoint says; the degradation is the silent fix, the search-and-replace that satisfies the checker while the label still claims what it claimed about the old text, so the cascade is cleared and the edge is now a false claim that passes; the tell is a label unchanged over an endpoint that changed, and the changed move is to re-author every label the cascade named rather than to re-point it; observed; adds to form-yields' graph the fact that in a composition the graph's edges are held by string identity, so the form's yield after a repair is the list of edges the repair invalidated, which is a distinction no author of the edges had when writing them.

Register rotation diff: the same subject is enumerated under a second register and the two lists are compared, so the composition yields the register's artifacts as a set, items that fail to survive the rotation, and the subject's members as the rest, which register-yields can name for one item and this composition reads for the whole list, as the atlas's register roster, whose thirty-odd registers each assert an unlock and whose rotation over one list would sort its items by which registers keep them, the field guide's species list beside the statute's protected list for the same coast, the same case argued in the legal and the clinical register; the composition's shape is two passes over one subject and a diff; what crosses is the subject's name and the item type, and not the first list; the judgment sits in the reader of the diff, who rules on whether a lost item was the register's or a subject's member the second register cannot reach, which are the two readings of every non-overlap; the degradation is the translation, since a rotator shown the first list writes the first list in the second voice, the diff is empty, and the empty diff reads as all subject and no artifact; the tell is a second list with the same count in the same order; analytical, since the roster exists and the rotation over any list has not been run; adds to register-yields' tell, that an item which cannot be restated flat was the register's, the operational form of that tell, a second register instead of the flat one and the whole list at once.

residue.item: Precedence: the first pass to write a field owns it, so the authored seriation blocks the measured one.
residue.why: Merged into Measure then name as its second observed shape; one mechanism, the split of measuring from naming, with precedence as the case where the naming half arrived first.

residue.item: Re-proposal without memory: the gate is never shown the ledger's residue, so a refused candidate returns as new.
residue.why: Merged into Cheap proposer, strong gate as its second degradation; the rate is unmeasured and no item was warranted on a mechanism with no count.

limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy; a real pipeline runs several of these compositions at once, often one inside another, and the list makes no claim to cover every shape.

The seriation is an itinerary of what crosses between the passes, not a ranking of value or reliability; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the loop, the two incompatibilities, the dependency, and the passage they draw are interpretations.

The atlas cases are read from the passes' code and from ledger and critique counts computed by script on 2026-09-13 (thirty-eight critiques, two hundred and eight repairs, one hundred and thirty-eight keeps, three cuts, eleven boundary cases matching a residue handle, fifty-five of eighty-two ledgers with more than one hand); they are counts of files by string match, not a human read of each, and the residue match is a floor. The trial, the parley, and the triangulation are designs with no transcript in the corpus, and their items say so.

Outside cases (crossover trials, Delphi panels, the Paris tasting, blind auditions, ensemble forecasting, the reading programme and its antedatings, Mendeleev's eka-silicon, compilers' error lists, closing-argument order) are simplified to one mechanism each; Telling the seat its attractor is speculative and predicts a shift this fleet has not yet shown.

The doctrine of splitting generator from critic is the catalog's own and is not an item. seed: The report that does not move the seat. This fleet is the first turn of the map's loop, and six of six seats named the report and returned the modal verdict anyway, so there is a mechanism the map points at and does not contain: an instruction crossing into a seat is absorbed as acknowledgment, the seat proves it read the report by citing it, and the distribution stands. Its carrier is the same one-sentence report, its seat is still the menu, and its tell is a critique whose strongest objection quotes the brief's warning while its verdict is the one warned against. The counterfactual is cheap and specific: rerun one map's critique with the menu's costs made symmetric (an admit must carry as much checked evidence as a reject) and the report withheld, and see whether the verdict moves when the cost moves and not when the report does.
